C1243.title: Grey Cash-Out Schemes Spread: 'Huabei and Baitiao Cash-Out' Ads Appear on Shared Bikes
C1243.summary: Public reports state that China’s first criminal case involving illegal Huabei cash-out was sentenced at the Chongqing Jiangbei District People’s Court. The defendant colluded with e-commerce users to fabricate transactions, convert Huabei credit limits into cash, and charge fees, with the conduct treated as illegal business activity. The case is a typical example of internet credit-payment limits being cashed out through sham transactions. Similar cash-out chains usually hide the real use of funds behind sham transactions, damaging credit-payment rules and potentially intertwining with fee extraction, merchant volume manipulation, and gray-market fund flows.
